text:
Predicates:
OlympicGames(x) ::: x is a summer Olympic games.
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
LastOlympicsLocation(x, y) ::: x is the location of the last summer Olympic games.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in y.
Premises:
OlympicGames(summer) ∧ SportingEvent(summer) ::: The summer Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastOlympicsLocation(summer, tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(unitedStates, tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
¬LastOlympicsLocation(summer, tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games were not in Tokyo.
